stem.text: A motor boat vibrates in the water so that it produces water waves of frequency $0.20\,\text{Hz}$. The speed of these waves in the water is $20\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The motor boat moves with a speed of $5.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ directly towards a stationary sailing boat.
The Doppler effect equation for sound waves also applies to water waves.
What is the frequency with which the waves hit the stationary sailing boat?
